tenderSchedule.description: PROCUREMENT OF FLOW TRASMITTER WITH SENSOR
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office BTPS Bellary

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three/five years2 and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.
The intending bidder shall be OEM/OES/Authorized dealer/Supplier of Flow meter sensor/I & C spares to any power plant/Process industries. the agency shall furnish documentary proof.

The intending bidder should have supplied similar type of materials/any I & C materials to any power plant/ process industry. As proof, the bidder shall furnish a copy of purchase order with a minimum value of Rs.4.00/- lakhs in a single order, executed in any one year during the preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Orginal signed past PO copy

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder, in their own name, shall have achieved an average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.8.00/- lakhs in any two years during the last five years. Documentary evidence in support of the same shall be furnished in the form of certified copies of the Profit and Loss account or turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.
The declaration duly signed in the prescribed format (Annexure - II) has to be enclosed.
